identificationModule.briefTitle: Recombinant Human Keratinocyte Growth Factor in Unrelated and Related Transplants
identificationModule.officialTitle: Safety and Efficacy of Recombinant Human Keratinocyte Growth Factor in Unrelated and Related Transplants

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a single arm dose escalation study of recombinant human keratinocyte growth factor given to patients undergoing allogeneic bone marrow transplantation who are at high risk for graft versus host disease (GVHD).
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Completion date provided represents the completion date of the grant per OOPD records

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: Eligible for full intensity bone marrow transplant (BMT) conditioning but who lack a 6/6 HLA idential sibling donor
